'''Zombies''' in [[Daemonheim]] can be found on [[abandoned 1 floor|abandoned 1]] and [[abandoned 2 floor|2]], [[occult floor|occult]] and [[warped floor]]s.

They have high constitution but very poor defence, and their attacks are somewhat accurate. They can be seen using hatchets, and can drop them on rare occasions. They can also be summoned by [[Forgotten necromancer]]s on any floor. Summoned zombies die after a short period of time, and will only drop bones. These zombies are weak to [[fire spells]].
